title: Water supply role in county planning and subdivisions
summary: On September 17, the board voted to ask the planning director to respond to its letter, with five ayes. It also voted unanimously to ask the planning and water supply directors to jointly attend a meeting and explain their roles in securing water supply for subdivision applications. The letter to the planning department on water supply in the planning process, with its problem statement and discussion questions, was approved unanimously on August 20.

A board member asked to add an item on the need for a Department of Water Supply verification letter for subdivision development.
